overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to specifically identify the location of its January 21, 2016 meeting, which was held in an unlisted Town Manager's office before executive session; it cannot withhold those executive session minutes under the OML.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly convened its January 21, 2016 meeting in a private, unposted location before entering executive session.
allegations.key_passage: By opening the January 21, 2016 meeting in the Town Manager's office, a location that was not listed on the meeting notice, the Board denied the public the opportunity to attend and observe whether the Board properly followed the procedural requirements for entering executive session, as outlined above.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

The Board may not rely upon the Open Meeting Law as the basis for continuing to withhold the minutes of the January 21, 2016 executive session; attorney-client privilege or Public Records Law exemptions may still apply.
